description: Implementation of the HpackDecoderStringBuffer class for handling HPACK string buffers in HTTP/2 header compression, including methods for managing buffer states, Huffman decoding, and string retrieval.

classes.name: HpackDecoderStringBuffer
classes.description: Manages the buffer for HPACK string decoding, including state management, Huffman decoding, and string extraction.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer state to initial.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the buffer with a string value and static flag.

methods.name: OnStart
methods.description: Begins processing a new string, setting Huffman encoding and length.

methods.name: OnData
methods.description: Processes incoming data chunks for the current string.

methods.name: OnEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the string processing, verifying Huffman encoding if applicable.

methods.name: BufferStringIfUnbuffered
methods.description: Buffers the string if it was previously unbuffered.

methods.name: IsBuffered
methods.description: Checks if the string is currently buffered.

methods.name: BufferedLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the buffered string.

methods.name: GetStringIfComplete
methods.description: Returns the string if processing is complete.

methods.name: ReleaseString
methods.description: Releases and returns the buffered string, resetting state.
